tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2612P Basic HD IP Phone With Adapter is a professional-grade VoIP phone designed for businesses, offices, call centers, and enterprise communication environments. Equipped with 4 SIP accounts, 4 line keys, integrated PoE support, HD audio technology, and a 2.4-inch color LCD display, the GRP2612P provides reliable, crystal-clear communication and efficient call management.


As part of Grandstream's carrier-grade GRP series, the GRP2612P offers centralized cloud management through GDMS, enterprise-level security, and easy deployment for organizations of all sizes. Its support for virtual BLF keys, 5-way audio conferencing, and advanced noise reduction technology makes it an excellent choice for modern business communication systems.


Key Features


  • Supports 4 SIP accounts and 4 line keys
  • Integrated PoE (Power over Ethernet)
  • 2.4-inch color LCD display (320 × 240)
  • HD audio on handset and speakerphone
  • Up to 16 virtual BLF keys
  • 5-way audio conferencing
  • Dual 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports
  • Noise Shield technology for enhanced voice clarity
  • GDMS cloud-based device management
  • Enterprise-grade security protection
  • Secure boot and encrypted data storage
  • Swappable faceplate for custom branding
  • Wall-mountable design
  • Power adapter included
